Title: Grilled Shrimp Skewers with Mint Salsa Verde
Protein Cut: Large or jumbo shrimp (peeled & deveined, tail-on)
Ingredients: 1 lb large raw shrimp (peeled & deveined) | 1 tbsp + 1 tsp fresh lemon juice | 2 tbsp olive oil | 1 clove garlic, minced | Salsa Verde: 3 green onions (chopped), 1/4 cup fresh mint, 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, 1 tbsp capers, 1/2 jalapeño (seeded), 1/4 cup plain low-fat Greek yogurt, 2 tbsp water, salt and pepper to taste
Instructions: 1. In small glass dish, whisk 1/2 tbsp plus 1 tsp lemon juice, 1 tsp olive oil, and minced garlic. Add shrimp, turning to coat; cover and refrigerate for 10 minutes (turning once). 2. For salsa verde: In mini food processor, pulse green onions, mint, cilantro, capers, jalapeño, yogurt, water, salt, pepper, remaining 1/2 tbsp lemon juice, and remaining 1 tbsp olive oil for 30 seconds until smooth and creamy. 3. Preheat grill pan over medium-high heat; spray lightly with cooking spray. Remove shrimp from marinade and discard marinade. 4. Grill shrimp for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until pink, pearly, and opaque throughout (145°F). 5. Drizzle with salsa verde and serve.
Source: Heart Healthy Recipe Guide - HFSA (Section: Seafood Entrées, Page 40)
Notes: Cooking time & doneness: Source specifies 2 to 3 minutes per side on medium-high grill pan until shrimp turn pearly and opaque throughout. Matches FDA guidance for shellfish safety.

Title: Shrimp Sauté with Garlic, Tomato, and Linguini
Ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp (peeled & deveined) | 8 oz linguini pasta | 2 tbsp olive oil | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 2 medium fresh tomatoes, diced | 1/2 cup white cooking wine or chicken broth | 1/4 cup reserved pasta water | Pinch of crushed red pepper flakes (optional)
Instructions: 1. Boil linguini in pot of water until al dente; drain, reserving 1/4 cup starchy pasta water. 2. Heat olive oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add minced garlic and diced tomatoes; sauté 2-3 minutes until soft and fragrant. 3. Add raw shrimp to skillet; sauté 1 minute. 4. Pour in white wine or broth; simmer 2-3 minutes until liquid reduces slightly and shrimp are curled, pink, and opaque. 5. Add cooked linguini directly to skillet, tossing with sauce (add splashes of reserved pasta water if dry). 6. Garnish with red pepper flakes and serve immediately.
Source: ENGLISH - Boston.gov (Section: Boston Community Cookbook - Seafood)
Notes: Precision flash-cooking: Boston community chef instructs sautéing raw shrimp for only 1 minute before adding liquid for a brief 2-3 minute simmer, avoiding rubbery overcooked shrimp.

Title: Quick & Easy Weeknight Shrimp Tacos with Slaw
Ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp (peeled & deveined) | 1 tbsp olive oil | 1 tsp chili powder | 1/2 tsp ground cumin | 1/2 tsp garlic powder | 1/4 tsp salt | 8 warm small corn tortillas | 2 cups shredded cabbage slaw | Chipotle crema (Greek yogurt, chipotle in adobo, lime juice) | Fresh cilantro and lime wedges
Instructions: 1. Pat shrimp dry; toss with olive oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and salt. 2. Heat large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Add shrimp in single layer; cook 2 minutes on first side, flip, and cook 1 to 2 minutes more until pink and opaque. Transfer to plate. 4. Warm corn tortillas in dry skillet. 5. Assemble tacos with shredded cabbage, seared shrimp, drizzle of chipotle crema, and fresh cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.
Source: Healthy Weeknight Dinners You'll Actually Crave - Dishing Out Health (Section: Quick Weeknight Tacos)
Notes: High-heat timing: 2 minutes first side, 1-2 minutes second side. Shellfish meat cooks rapidly; remove immediately upon turning opaque to preserve tender texture.

Title: Quick Shrimp and Veggie Sauté Lo Mein
Ingredients: 1 lb raw peeled shrimp | 8 oz noodles | 1 cup sugar snap peas | 1 red bell pepper, thinly sliced | 2 cups shredded cabbage | 2 tbsp soy sauce | 1 tbsp oyster sauce | 1 tsp sesame oil | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 tsp grated ginger
Instructions: 1. Cook noodles according to package instructions; drain. Whisk soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil in small cup. 2. Heat 1 tbsp oil in large wok over high heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, stir-frying 30 seconds. 3. Add shrimp; stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes until pink and cooked through; transfer to plate. 4. Add bell peppers, snap peas, and cabbage to wok; stir-fry 2 minutes until tender-crisp. 5. Return shrimp and cooked noodles to wok, pour in sauce, and toss vigorously 1 minute until well coated.
Source: Healthy Weeknight Dinners You'll Actually Crave - Dishing Out Health (Section: Easy Noodle & Stir Fry Mains)
Notes: Batch stir-frying: Shrimp is cooked separately for 2-3 minutes to prevent overcooking while crisp vegetables and noodles are tossed.

Title: Thai Red Curry Shrimp with Vegetables
Ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp (peeled & deveined) | 1 tbsp coconut oil | 2 tbsp Thai red curry paste | 1 can (13.5 oz) light coconut milk | 1 cup chicken or vegetable broth | 1 red bell pepper, sliced | 1 cup bamboo shoots | 1 tbsp fish sauce | 1 tsp brown sugar | Fresh Thai basil leaves
Instructions: 1. Heat coconut oil in large saucepan over medium heat; add red curry paste and cook 1 minute until fragrant. 2. Whisk in coconut milk and broth; bring to gentle boil. 3. Add sliced bell pepper and bamboo shoots; simmer 4-5 minutes until tender. 4. Stir in fish sauce and brown sugar. 5. Add raw shrimp; simmer gently for 3 to 4 minutes until shrimp are pink and opaque throughout. 6. Remove from heat, stir in fresh Thai basil leaves, and serve with jasmine rice.
Source: Recipes - The Nutrition Source | Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health (Section: Healthy Seafood Curries)
Notes: Gentle poaching: Shrimp are added at the very end of curry preparation, simmering for only 3-4 minutes to gently reach 145°F without boiling vigorously.

Title: Traditional Shrimp & Chicken Okra Gumbo
Ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp (peeled & deveined) | 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cubed | 2 tbsp olive oil | 1 medium onion, diced | 1 green bell pepper, diced | 2 ribs celery, diced | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 2 cups sliced fresh or frozen okra | 1 can (14.5 oz) crushed tomatoes | 4 cups low-sodium chicken broth | 1 tsp Creole seasoning | 1 bay leaf
Instructions: 1. Heat oil in large Dutch oven over medium heat. Sauté onion, bell pepper, and celery (the holy trinity) for 5 minutes. 2. Add minced garlic and cubed chicken; cook 4 minutes. 3. Stir in sliced okra, crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, Creole seasoning, and bay leaf. 4. Bring to simmer, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook 25 minutes. 5. Stir in raw shrimp; simmer uncovered for 4 to 5 minutes until shrimp turn pink and opaque. 6. Discard bay leaf and serve over brown or white rice.
Source: Recipes - The Nutrition Source | Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health (Section: Traditional Soups & Gumbos)
Notes: Seafood addition sequence: Adding shrimp in the final 4-5 minutes of stew simmering prevents delicate seafood proteins from contracting into rubbery textures.

Title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Scampi
Protein Cut: Large or jumbo shrimp (peeled & deveined, tail-on)
Ingredients: 1.25 lbs large raw shrimp | 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil | 2 tbsp unsalted butter | 4 cloves garlic, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice | 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tbsp chopped fresh Italian parsley | Salt and black pepper
Instructions: 1. Pat shrimp dry with paper towels; season with salt and pepper. 2. Heat olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Add sliced garlic and red pepper flakes; cook 30 seconds until garlic is fragrant but not browned. 4. Add shrimp in single layer; cook 2 minutes without moving. 5. Flip shrimp, pour in white wine and lemon juice, and cook 2 minutes more. 6. Remove skillet from heat, swirl in remaining 1 tbsp butter and chopped parsley until sauce emulsifies. 7. Serve immediately with crusty bread or over pasta.
Source: 45 Healthy Comfort Food Recipes That Are Packed with Flavor - Food Network (Section: Classic Healthy Seafood)
Notes: Cooking velocity: 2 minutes per side in hot skillet; acidity from white wine and lemon juice completes emulsion with butter off heat.
